scripts.test: bun run test:unit && bun run test:cli && bun run test:library
scripts.test:cli: bun run prepare:source-cli && bun run leia examples/source/README.md --test-header 'Testing CLI' --shell bash --retry 0 --timeout 10
scripts.test:library: bun run leia examples/source/README.md --test-header 'Testing Library' --shell bash --retry 0 --timeout 10
scripts.test:integration: bun run test:integration:cli && bun run test:integration:library
scripts.test:integration:cli: bun run prepare:source-cli && bun run leia examples/l337/README.md examples/lando/README.md --test-header 'Testing CLI' --shell bash --retry 0 --timeout 300
scripts.test:integration:library: bun run leia examples/consumer/README.md --test-header 'Testing Library' --shell bash --retry 0 --timeout 300
scripts.lint: bun run lint:eslint && bun run format:check
